notes: Read-only projection; must not own tool execution or writes.
Phase 2A.0 remains specification-only; Phase 2A.1/2A.2 code is merged but rollout is flag-gated.
Do not automatically load approval history for a Core Reasoning-only task.

tma_api.py is listed above as both the only live caller of this projection AND the write side (patch_lead(), _OUTCOME_STATUS_MAP) — this layer's own read-only scope does not make tma_api.py read-only; a 'wrong reasoning state' symptom can originate on either side and both must be opened, not just the read/normalization path.

core/adapters/decision_adapter.py is the current, live module for the Decision-domain reasoning entity; a module historically named decision_orchestrator.py no longer exists on main (its role was migrated here, see decision_adapter.py's own header comment) — do not search for that filename. This is also where the still-open SPEC ambiguity lives: PHASE_CLOSED (core/reasoning_entity.py) is reused for both Decision-cancellation and Lead administrative-closure (decision_adapter.py:148), which is a documented open question, not a coding error, per the 2026-07-28 N17 pilot Task 4 finding.
